intent: Relate Notes-owned research to developing or monitoring theses by direct semantic bearing while preserving exact promoted-claim provenance and unresolved judgment boundaries.
contract: Given one complete current Notes-owned research insight, the complete Trade Journal promoted-claim identity catalog, current developing and monitoring macro and asset thesis arguments, existing governed relationships, and validated Registry-resolved claims-synthesis and research-publication facts where needed, deterministically prepare a provider-neutral recommendation-only bearing result. Reuse exact provenance-bearing claims regardless of lifecycle status; never duplicate or directly publish a Notes source claim. A relation requires direct semantic proof between an exact source claim assertion and a governed thesis argument; holdings, tickers, keywords, and provider recommendations are never proof. Preserve evidence, reasoning, backing, qualifier, every rebuttal, time horizon, relationship rationale, audit context, and explicit ambiguity. Genuine claim-identity or thesis-bearing judgment becomes an unresolved Decision Item candidate and is never silently resolved. Persistence requires a short-lived exact user authorization and the sole serializable recorder, which may only reuse or insert exact claim_thesis_mappings and insert unresolved Decision Items plus one complete journal audit. Refuse unavailable, stale, malformed, ambiguous, conflicting, expired, or authority-expanding input without partial writes.
instructions: Require one explicit Trade Journal research insight ID. Read it only through scripts/belief-research-relation.ts --prepare --insight-id <uuid>, which loads complete Notes/Tana provenance, the complete promoted-claim identity catalog, all developing and monitoring thesis arguments, and existing governed relationships through approved repository helpers. It exposes no write mode.

Notes/Tana owns capture, source material, and Toulmin extraction. Trade Journal owns promoted investment claims, theses, governed claim-thesis relationships, publication state, unresolved Decision Items, and journal audit. Preserve source evidence, claim identity, thesis bearing, relationship semantics, authorization, persistence, and audit as distinct concepts.

Resolve capability:scope:trade-journal/claims-synthesis and capability:scope:trade-journal/research-publication through the published Registry Lock. Claims synthesis and provider output are recommendations, not semantic proof or authorization. A relation may reference only an exact existing provenance-bearing main_claims row or an authority-approved research-publication result that has already created that promoted claim. This recorder never creates main_claims rows.

Exact (sourceInsightId, sourceClaimId) provenance is deterministic identity regardless of claim lifecycle status. Reuse it and refuse duplicate or ambiguous provenance. Preserve evidence, reasoning, backing, qualifier, every rebuttal, time horizon, tickers, Notes content digest, and explicit ambiguity.

Judge research by direct semantic bearing on the governed core argument, drivers, or assumptions of developing or monitoring theses. Holdings are not an information gate. Ticker overlap and keyword overlap are retrieval hints only. A provider recommendation is not proof. Every relation must carry exact claim and thesis anchors plus the explicit causal, evidential, qualifying, or refuting connection.

Validate recommendation-only output through scripts/belief-research-relation.ts --validate-result <file|-> --context <file>. Every source claim must be covered by exact high-confidence relations, explicit claim_identity or thesis_bearing ambiguity, or an unrelated rationale; never combine ambiguity with a silent link. Keep output bounded to at most 25 source claims and five relations per claim.

Prepare persistence through scripts/belief-research-relation.ts --prepare-recording --result <file|-> --context <file>. Only direct high-confidence relations to existing exact provenance claims become relationship candidates. Claim-publication requirements are exclusions. Ambiguities with an existing claim anchor become unresolved confirm_claim_link Decision Item candidates; this Capability never resolves them.

Present exact relationship and Decision Item candidates to the current user. Only that user's explicit selection may be serialized into a version 1.0.0 belief_research_relation_authorization token valid for no more than 24 hours, cryptographically bound to recordingDigest and naming unique acceptedRelationIds and acceptedDecisionIds with the exact contract statement. Never infer, fabricate, broaden, or self-authorize a token.

Validate the token without writes through scripts/belief-research-relation.ts --validate-authorization <file|-> --recording <file>. When and only when it encodes the current user's explicit decision, pipe the complete { prepared, authorization } envelope once to scripts/ops/record-belief-research-relation.ts --stdin. Provider adapters have no direct database authority.

The recorder uses one serializable transaction and authorization lock; revalidates the exact current context, provenance identities, developing or monitoring thesis eligibility, and existing mappings; retries serialization and uniqueness races with a fresh snapshot; reuses only an exact relationship or inserts the exact accepted claim_thesis_mappings columns; inserts accepted unresolved decision_required journal entries with resolution null; inserts one belief_research_relation_recorded journal audit with digest-bound authorization, candidates, actual records, exclusions, permitted surface, and forbidden authority; returns exact created/reused dispositions and write counts; and makes canonically identical retries idempotent.

The maximum tables are claim_thesis_mappings and journal_entries with only the declared columns. Never create or mutate main_claims, research artifacts or insights, thesis state or status, signals, strategies, positions, orders, or trades; never resolve a Decision Item; and never use ad-hoc SQL, Supabase MCP writes, direct API mutation, generic writers, temporary write scripts, or live-provider output as authority.

Treat missing, incomplete, malformed, stale, unavailable, authority-ambiguous, or conflicting inputs; absent user acceptance; expired authorization; sandbox denial; transaction or audit failure; and provider unavailability as unavailable, refused, or failed with no partial success. Do not invoke a live provider or mutate production data to manufacture evidence.

Unattended execution may prepare and validate recommendation-only results and return explicit ambiguities. It cannot create an authorization token, invoke the recorder, link a claim, surface a persisted Decision Item, change status, or make genuine judgment. Its genuine unattended eligibility is therefore conditional for read-only preparation and ineligible for all writes.

requirements.description: Each exact provider adapter is present in the staged governed Provider Entry Point generated from this package.

The deterministic read boundary accepts complete Notes provenance, exact claim identity, developing and monitoring thesis arguments, and existing relationships while refusing unavailable, malformed, stale, or authority-ambiguous state.
Only direct semantic bearing can produce a relation; holdings, tickers, keywords, and provider recommendations are rejected as proof, and exact provenance forces reuse without claim duplication.
Claim-identity and thesis-bearing ambiguity remain explicit and persistence can only surface unresolved Decision Items without resolving them.
The sole serializable recorder revalidates current state, writes only exact mappings and journal rows, produces a complete digest-bound audit, is idempotent, and rolls back partial failure.

Provider adapters refuse claim creation, status or decision resolution, strategies, positions, trades, APIs, Supabase MCP, ad-hoc SQL, generic writes, schedulers, credentials, and active operational cutover.

The exact Claude and Codex adapters preserve Notes/Trade Journal authority, direct semantic bearing, provenance reuse, explicit ambiguity, user authorization, transaction semantics, and the genuine-judgment boundary.
The repository runtime executes non-mutating help, preparation, validation, refusal, and controlled transaction paths while missing prerequisites remain explicit unavailable outcomes.
